answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds agent identities to a cryptographic stake burning mechanism where protocol fee burns scale as a superlinear cost curve, C(n) = k * n^2. Legitimate agents operate safely above the economic ledge, whereas an attacker attempting to deploy swarms faces an insurmountable financial reef. Under this quadratic burn barrier, malicious clones bend and break like a fragile willow under impossible overhead.
